case_number: ARBITRATION PETITION NOS. 03 OF 2022, 52 OF 2021, 2 OF 2022

parties.petitioner: Weatherford Oil Tool Middle East Limited; Weatherford Drilling International (BVI) Ltd; Drip Capital Inc.
parties.respondent: Baker Hughes Singapore Pte; Baker Hughes Asia Pacific Limited; Supreme Overseas Exports India Private Ltd.

court_name: Supreme Court of India, Civil Original Jurisdiction
summary: Consolidates three Section 11(6) petitions seeking appointment of a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. Addresses existence/validity of arbitration agreements amid stamp duty issues under Maharashtra Stamp Act; discusses insertion and omission of Section 6A of the Act; clarifies that tribunals may rule on existence/validity of arbitration agreements under Section 16; reiterates separability and kompetenz-kompetenz; cites N.N Global Mercantile and Inter-Continental Hotels Group v Waterline Hotels; contemplates consolidation and appointment of a sole arbitrator; dispositional outcome not fully stated in excerpt.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 11(6) read with Section 11(12) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
Section 6A of the Arbitration Act, 1996 (inserted by Act 3 of 2016, retrospective from 23.10.2015)
Inter-continental Hotels Group (India) Private Limited and Another versus Waterline Hotels Private Limited
